# Agentic First

Canonical site:

- https://agentic-first.co/

Alternate domain:

- https://agent-first.co/ redirects to https://agentic-first.co/

## What This Repo Owns

This repo owns the top-level Agentic First orientation site and route map.
It introduces Agentic First as a way to make organisations legible to
agents, then routes users into the company/profile directory, the Tool
Directory, and Tony Wood's writing on agentic systems, governance, and
operations.

## Product Areas

- Company/profile directory: https://agentic-first.co/companies/
- Company/profile MCP: https://agentic-first.co/companies/mcp
- Company/profile machine index: https://agentic-first.co/companies/llms.txt
- Agentics Tool Directory: https://agentic-first.co/directory/
- Tool Directory machine index: https://agentic-first.co/directory/llms.txt
- Product source: https://github.com/yqup/pitch-mcp
